b1-nuevasrepublicas-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Gran Colombia
b1-nuevasrepublicas-01.scenario: You are Meg. You read a book about Bolívar, and Carlos asks what happened to the Gran Colombia.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-01.prompt: Tell Carlos when the Gran Colombia was created and dissolved.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-01.target: La Gran Colombia fue creada en 1819, y fue disuelta en 1830 y 1831. Se formaron Venezuela, Ecuador y Nueva Granada.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-01.english: The Gran Colombia was created in 1819, and it was dissolved in 1830 and 1831. Venezuela, Ecuador and Nueva Granada were formed.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-01.canDo: I can say when the Gran Colombia was created and dissolved.

b1-nuevasrepublicas-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Uti Possidetis
b1-nuevasrepublicas-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You had a class about borders in Latin America, and Meg asks what uti possidetis was.
cues: Say what historians say about the disputes
b1-nuevasrepublicas-02.target: Según este principio, cada país conservaba los límites coloniales. Según los historiadores, hubo muchas disputas.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-02.english: According to this principle, each country kept the colonial limits. According to historians, there were many disputes.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-02.canDo: I can explain the principle of uti possidetis and why it still caused border disputes.

b1-nuevasrepublicas-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Liberals and Conservatives
b1-nuevasrepublicas-03.scenario: You are Meg. You watched a documentary about the 19th century, and Carlos asks what liberals and conservatives disagreed about.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what they disagreed about.
cues: Say what the two groups had in common
Say what they disagreed about, with a connector
b1-nuevasrepublicas-03.target: Los liberales y los conservadores eran de la élite; sin embargo, tenían ideas diferentes sobre la Iglesia.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-03.english: Liberals and conservatives were from the elite; however, they had different ideas about the Church.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-03.canDo: I can say what liberals and conservatives disagreed about, starting with the Church.

b1-nuevasrepublicas-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Pronunciamientos
b1-nuevasrepublicas-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You read a book about Mexico, and Meg asks why governments changed so often.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-04.prompt: Tell Meg what used to happen in Mexico.
cues: Say how long presidents used to govern
Say what an officer used to do
b1-nuevasrepublicas-04.target: Los presidentes solían gobernar poco tiempo. Un oficial solía escribir un plan y pedir apoyo a otros soldados.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-04.english: Presidents used to govern for a short time. An officer used to write a plan and ask other soldiers for support.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-04.canDo: I can say what presidents and officers used to do in Mexico after independence.

b1-nuevasrepublicas-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Balance of 1850
b1-nuevasrepublicas-05.scenario: You are Meg. You had a class about the first decades of independence, and Carlos asks for a summary.
cues: Say what Mexico lost in 1846 to 1848
b1-nuevasrepublicas-05.target: En resumen, los nuevos países tenían tres grandes desafíos. México perdió cerca de la mitad de su territorio en la guerra con los Estados Unidos.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-05.english: In summary, the new countries had three big challenges. Mexico lost about half its territory in the war with the United States.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-05.canDo: I can summarise the main challenges of the new republics around 1850.

b1-nuevasrepublicas-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: New Republics Review
b1-nuevasrepublicas-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You visited a museum about the new republics with a friend, and Meg asks what you learned.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg one thing about unions and one about politics.
cues: Say what happened to the Gran Colombia
Say what presidents used to do
b1-nuevasrepublicas-consolidation.target: La Gran Colombia fue disuelta en 1830. Los presidentes de México solían gobernar poco tiempo.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-consolidation.english: The Gran Colombia was dissolved in 1830. Presidents of Mexico used to govern for a short time.
b1-nuevasrepublicas-consolidation.canDo: I can say what happened to some early unions and why politics was unstable.
